name: Roam
body:
School transformation; Level bloodrager 2, hunter 2, magus 3, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard

Casting Time 1 swift action

Components V, S

Range personal

Duration 1 round

Until the start of your next turn, every time you make a melee or ranged weapon attack (including any attacks of opportunity you make), you can also choose to immediately move five feet. This movement is not impeded by difficult terrain and does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You must make the decision whether or not to take this free movement immediately after you make each attack, and before your next attack or other action (if any) is taken.
